title: Kabri farmo quuka
intro: qadli le rooci miraacisuh ruube ummatta bayteh tumbulleh ane wayta qellatitteh addat. Tama farmoyti ginoh yaakumik ciggil sadah yan umaadoobal kaxxa maabitina xayyoysak maqar luk sooleh. Faxennal assakat le xaaqo, ayyunti ditet rade, gudgud gulgul qibaadah cisab gersiimih inna hinna. Atu tama Yallih sabhalal le taama-maqaane baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu gersi kaxxa nabiyyih ramad sugeeh, kaa lih dabboh gexe, ni baaxo darrel cabak.
Anu umaanet keenik baxsale mara fan ruubeeh, keenik afal uli gino abe weeh yan qellat.
Yi buxah mari kurruumak suge; xayi buxah marih adoytit sirrit kaafir luk xaqut yan.
Malaykoota, qaxmeqe qunxa marih weelol, yi buxah qibnaytiino luk temeeteeh, ken amaanah kaxxa taqabi yoh bahte.
Anu inni say xaylo inni ummattah digibih xayyoyseh suge, ken qaybik tan abtootak ken yayyaaqeenimih niya yirgiqeh.
Yi ummatta bohoy le weeqaa kee laqlaqen xaahi robti robti addat finqitteeh, yoo kee yi buxah mara, inki num dubuk, barti raboytit cabneh.

identity.label: Anu miyyaay?
options: Shuqayb farmoyta
Nabi Saalih
Nabiyyi Luut
Huud farmoyti
Nuuc farmoyti

trial.label: Yok naharsi gibbati macak sugteeh?
options: qangiino le amoyti girat yoo carrise wayuh geysiisam.
yi toobokoh aysinu lih taamitaanam kee qeeli addat qidaanam.
fooca fan ummattat tengeleh tan fidoh angaaraw umaane.
yi ummatta caylale firqawni naqoosak yayyaaqeenimi.
Mu'miniin kaxxa weeqi catnuh kaxxa markab xisaanama.
trial.answer: fooca fan ummattat tengeleh tan fidoh angaaraw umaane.

location.label: Yi farmo elle sugte arac macak sugteeh?

outcome.label: Illacaboh Xalooti Maca Sugteeh?
options: Magaalol korsimteh sugteeh, alaysen kallayto xaatitteh kaqalte.
Yi ummatta ken gaddali mirac lih ardi tunxuqeh sugte.
Yi ummatta malcina bar kee bacra ayroh caylale silaytut finqitteh.
Yi ummatta qanaytuuy, inkaqtaa kee baxannah innah tan dadhoytit biyaakitteh sugte.
Anu inni farmo cabeek widiril kaxxa kullumti yoo yanxuqeh.
outcome.answer: Magaalol korsimteh sugteeh, alaysen kallayto xaatitteh kaqalte.

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
verse: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were] (11:82)
